description: Fast-path alias cache for known field renames observed so far. This is NOT the sole schema-drift detection mechanism -- normalize.py's structural detector (a required canonical field missing + exactly one unmapped extra key of a compatible type/shape present) is what actually generalizes to a held-out seed with unseen rename names. This file is just a hint that lets already-seen renames skip the structural-inference step, Renames inferred at runtime are logged as SCHEMA_DRIFT events and are not written back to this file.
